refinements.outcome: Product decisions, compliance boundaries, commercial policies, and vendor activation gates are versioned before downstream services consume them.
refinements.context: Release 0 is the authority boundary for decisions that otherwise become conflicting defaults across Booking, Finance, Payment, Property, User, and external integrations.

decisions.question: Which aggregate names, identifiers, owners, and terminal states are approved as the shared domain glossary?

refinements.decisionNoteVi: Cần ProductOwner và ArchitectureOwner duyệt glossary/aggregate state model trước khi tách leaf triển khai; agent không được tự đặt tên hoặc tự chuyển quyền sở hữu dữ liệu.

implementationBlockers: A Channex sandbox tenant, API credentials, webhook signing material, and sandbox property identifier are required to prove the live contract.
refinements.decisionNoteVi: Đã chọn Channex; cần tài khoản sandbox và credentials để kiểm chứng API/webhook thật, không thể giả lập rồi coi là hoàn tất.

decisions.question: Which properties, users, opening balances, bookings, and exception cases form the pilot migration dataset?
Who owns go/no-go, rollback, reconciliation sign-off, and incident communication during cutover?

refinements.decisionNoteVi: Cần chốt dataset pilot và tên người chịu trách nhiệm RACI; các bước kỹ thuật có thể chuẩn bị nhưng không được tự suy đoán dữ liệu/cá nhân phê duyệt.

decisions.question: Which external employee or cleaning system is the target, and where is its authoritative API, signing, retry, and data-retention contract?

refinements.decisionNoteVi: Chưa xác định nhà cung cấp employee/cleaning system và contract chính thức; giữ decision-required thay vì tạo draft có vẻ hoàn chỉnh nhưng sai vendor.

refinements.outcome: Commercial policy schemas and their deployment gates are delivered by separate contract and infrastructure leaves without embedding production monetary defaults.
refinements.context: The parent coordinates schema authority in platform_contracts and enforcement/evidence in platform_infrastructure; only the two child slices are dispatchable.

refinements.outcome: Platform Contracts publishes machine-verifiable pricing, deposit, cancellation, refund, settlement, and trust-policy artifacts with explicit version and no production default values.
refinements.context: Existing pricing v1 documents and validation scripts are the baseline. This slice owns contract shape and fixtures only; runtime publication and secret values remain outside this repository.
inScope: Complete the commercial policy documents and machine-readable artifacts under docs/ for pricing publication, cancellation/deposit/refund, settlement, and customer trust inputs.
Add deterministic validation for version, effective time, approval state, supersession, numeric bounds, rounding, and absence of implicit production defaults.
Publish valid and invalid fixtures that downstream Booking and Finance implementations can consume without inventing fallback values.
stateMachine: Policy lifecycle is DRAFT -> APPROVED -> EFFECTIVE -> SUPERSEDED; only an approved version can become effective.
A new effective version supersedes rather than edits the previous version, preserving its fingerprint and evidence.
Missing approval, effective time, required bound, or production value fails validation and publication.

dataPartitions: SYSTEM policy catalogue; publication is restricted to the configured environment and policy family.
fieldGroups: POLICY_SUMMARY for readers; POLICY_DEFINITION and POLICY_APPROVAL for explicitly granted publishers.

contracts.name: COMMERCIAL_POLICY_V1
contracts.compatibility: Additive fields remain optional inside v1; a semantic or rounding change requires a new policy version and fingerprint.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a complete approved commercial policy fixture with bounded values and an effective time
acceptanceCriteria.then: it emits the documented deterministic fingerprint and accepts the fixture

acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture containing an implicit production monetary default, missing approval metadata, invalid percentage, or overlapping effective winner
acceptanceCriteria.then: validation fails with a stable diagnostic and publishes no fingerprint
the replacement uses a new version and supersession reference while the prior artifact remains unchanged

tests: Run the full platform contract suite and the focused pricing publication validator against valid and invalid fixtures.
Review the generated fingerprint twice from identical canonical input and verify byte-for-byte equality.

testCases.evidence: platform_contracts test log including validate-pricing-publication output and accepted fingerprint

testCases.command: manual: compare the approved artifact and its superseding fixture in the pull request
testCases.evidence: pull-request diff showing append-only versioning and no edit to the effective artifact

refinements.outcome: Infrastructure rejects unapproved commercial policy values and records repeatable local/CI evidence for the published pricing contract.
refinements.context: This slice consumes the contract artifact from platform_contracts. It does not own commercial formulas or commit environment secrets.
inScope: Wire the commercial-policy validation into infrastructure CI before compose or deployment artifacts are accepted.
Keep production policy values in environment/secret delivery and fail closed when required values or an approved fingerprint are absent.
Exercise the pricing Postman collection against deterministic local fixtures and retain the Newman-compatible result.
stateMachine: Environment policy state is MISSING, VALIDATED, or REJECTED; only VALIDATED may start the dependent pricing path.
Changing policy content without the approved fingerprint moves the environment to REJECTED.
Rollback selects a previously approved fingerprint and never mutates its contract artifact.

dataPartitions: ENVIRONMENT:LOCAL, ENVIRONMENT:UAT, or ENVIRONMENT:PRODUCTION; activation never crosses environments.
fieldGroups: POLICY_FINGERPRINT and ACTIVATION_STATUS are visible to operators; POLICY_SECRET_VALUE is never emitted to logs or Jira.

contracts.name: Pricing policy and quote validation flow
contracts.compatibility: The collection pins operation names and stable error codes while environment values remain external.

acceptanceCriteria.given: the approved policy artifact and matching fingerprint are supplied to local or CI configuration
acceptanceCriteria.when: the infrastructure validation and pricing collection run
acceptanceCriteria.then: the policy gate passes and pricing scenarios use that exact fingerprint

acceptanceCriteria.given: the fingerprint is missing, unapproved, or does not match policy content
acceptanceCriteria.when: compose or CI attempts to enable the pricing path
acceptanceCriteria.then: startup or validation fails closed without logging policy secrets

acceptanceCriteria.given: the same pricing collection is executed repeatedly against its deterministic fixture
acceptanceCriteria.then: results and stable error codes are repeatable and cleanup leaves no duplicated business effect

tests: Run infrastructure configuration validation and the focused Postman pricing script with approved and mismatched fingerprints.
Inspect CI and compose logs to confirm secret values are redacted and failure is explicit.

testCases.evidence: pricing Postman/Newman summary with fixture and policy fingerprint
configuration validation plus negative CI log for missing or mismatched fingerprint with secrets redacted
